offshore_v2.name: Southern East Madagascar Current
offshore_v2.scope: OSW offshore reference corridor for the southern branch along eastern Madagascar, from approximately20S to the offshore Cape Sainte Marie approach. Exact vertices and the southern26.1S offshore point are editorial choices around the coarse atlas coast, not observed core positions or the source coastal endpoint near25.5S. Excludes northern branch, undercurrent, rings, SICC and uncertain Mozambique Channel/Agulhas continuations.
offshore_v2.layer: Upper-current contextual geography; no fixed-depth or velocity-derived axis reconstructed. Excludes the equatorward undercurrent.
offshore_v2.time_convention: Undated contextual geography described by Nauw et al.2008, citing earlier studies; not an April2001 axis, seasonal state, annual mean or operational position.

offshore_v2.source_license: Original OSW factual paraphrase and editorial vertices; no publication, figure, station data or provider geometry redistributed.
offshore_v2.coordinate_selection: V1 rejected all27 scenarios on coarse land intersections; complete rejected input and attempts retained. V2 uses a declared farther-offshore corridor, including a26.1S Cape approach distinct from the source coastal point near25.5S. No bathymetric or current-axis verification. All27 cartographic sensitivities retained, no physical uncertainty or seasonal interpretation. No fitting to the published650km extent.
offshore_v2.scenario_rule: All27 predeclared cartographic scenarios: three common longitude shifts and three independent latitude choices at each endpoint. Retain every scenario; no fitted geometry or statistical uncertainty inferred.

offshore_v2.method: Sum shortest WGS84 geodesic distances between successive OSW editorial vertices; no velocity field or current core is reconstructed.
